messages:
release-manager: starting rollout for hotfix routing v2.2.1 — we need to enable the feature flag 'route-new-llm' in a staged fashion during tonight's change window (22:00-02:00 UTC). canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~90m ramp. tagging @maria-oncall @ops-lead

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout created: rollout_id=rr-20260320-09, window=2026-03-21T22:00Z..2026-03-22T02:00Z, stages=[canary,5,25,100]. notifications will post per stage.

jia: quick safety ask — add perf and error gates for each stage: 95p latency < 200ms and error_rate < 0.5% (5m rolling). if either fails, auto-drain to previous pin.

sam: agree. also recommend enabling the quick-unpin strategy on the 5% stage: if errors >1% for 3 consecutive 1m buckets, drop back to 0% and pin to v2.1.9.

ops-lead: noted. I'll add the gating rules to the rollout config. remember to mute non-essential alerts so we don't spam oncall.

release-manager: here's the exact ops command we'll run for the manual canary kick (if we need it):
```
# enable canary cohort only
ffctl toggle --flag route-new-llm --cohort canary --enable true --note "hotfix v2.2.1 canary"
# ramp example
ffctl ramp --flag route-new-llm --from 5 --to 25 --duration 30m
# pin command (on rollback)
configctl set model.routing.pin=\"v2.1.9\" --env prod
```

deploy-bot: preview of rollout config:
```
{
  "rollout_id": "rr-20260320-09",
  "stages": ["canary","5%","25%","100%"],
  "gates": {"latency_95p_ms": 200, "error_rate_pct": 0.5},
  "rollback_action": "pin_to_v2.1.9",
  "auto_unpin_on_failure": true
}
```

maria-oncall: I'll be on standby for the window. please DM if we need to escalate. I'll also have the emergency rollback checklist open.

infra-sre: two infra notes: 1) if KV cache warmup causes transient 5xxs during canary, do not auto-rollback until sustained >2m; add a short jitter-to-stability check. 2) disable model-quantization rebuilds during the window (avoid background compactions).

sam: adding threshold tweaks: for canary treat error_rate threshold as 1% transient tolerant for first 2min, then enforce 0.5% rolling. documented in the rollout config.

ops-lead: config updated and pushed to release-control: rr-20260320-09 with jia/sam/infrastructure notes. final approval?

release-manager: approved. starting preflight checks at 21:30Z. deploy-bot will announce canary enable at 22:00Z.

deploy-bot: preflight success: all services healthy, autoscaler steady, storage pressure nominal. will post stage updates to this thread.

maria-oncall: ack. I'll monitor logs + SRE dashboard. set pager to on. :thumbsup:

release-manager: if we hit an immediate safety condition use this shortcut to force a rollback:
```
ffctl toggle --flag route-new-llm --enable false --force --note "rollback due to safety-gate"
configctl set model.routing.pin="v2.1.9" --env prod --force
```

ops-lead: also leaving a short post-deploy checklist in case we go 100%: verify token-level cost delta < 1.5x and 7-day regressions for quality checks scheduled.

release-manager: thanks everyone. will report back at each stage and post release notes after final cutover."
